name: core
description: Framework core services — email, scheduling, browser automation

tools.name: email_send
tools.description: Send a single SMTP email to whitelisted recipients, with attachments

tools.name: schedule_followup
tools.description: Schedule a follow-up job for the agent itself, continuing the current task

tools.name: browser
tools.description: Playwright browser toolset master switch — every browser_* tool additionally requires its own key

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL (domain-checked against core/allowed_domains)

tools.name: browser_navigate_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture an accessibility snapshot of the current page

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the page or an element to an artifact file

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear, or for a fixed delay

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Run arbitrary JavaScript in the page — full page-context access

tools.name: browser_run_code
tools.description: Run arbitrary Playwright code — full browser-automation access

tools.name: browser_start_video
tools.description: Start recording a video of the browser session

tools.name: browser_stop_video
tools.description: Stop recording and save the session video as an artifact

tools.name: browser_start_tracing
tools.description: Start a Playwright trace recording

tools.name: browser_stop_tracing
tools.description: Stop the Playwright trace and save it

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover over an element

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into an element

tools.name: browser_fill_form
tools.description: Fill several form fields in one call

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select one or more options in a dropdown

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a key on the keyboard

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Drag one element onto another

tools.name: browser_file_upload
tools.description: Upload one or more files

tools.name: browser_handle_dialog
tools.description: Accept or dismiss a browser dialog

tools.name: browser_resize
tools.description: Resize the browser window

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close the page

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List, create, close or select browser tabs

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.description: Return console messages from the page

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.description: Return network requests made since loading the page

tools.name: browser_install
tools.description: Install the browser binary Playwright needs — infrastructure action
